name: ScummVM
description: ScummVM's Windows backend uses WinSparkle with the ScummVM appcast URL and delegates signed-package retrieval and installation to that framework. The reviewed application source does not expose a pinned EdDSA key, and the Linux updater behavior remains outside this evidence.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; WinSparkle/Sparkle dependency internals and platform-specific packaging were not audited, so key pinning remains unsubstantiated in this source review.
